PS: The King of Glory collaboration project was completed a long time ago. There's another one about Master Luban that will be published on the 25th. I'll also publish a single chapter when the time comes.

Also, I'm working on the new book. The framework is already set, and I'm filling in the details.

Actually, I can start writing the beginning now, but the framework of the theme this time is a little complicated. It's much harder to write than Mechanic, and I'm afraid that I won't be able to handle it well. I'm not afraid of being laughed at by my brothers, but I'm really afraid of writing the theme this time. Thus, I'm still looking for an entry point and perfecting the various elements of the story. I want to see how I can write it better. Otherwise, it'll be a pity for this theme. However, I can't do this for too long. The new book will probably be published in the next one or two months. It shouldn't be delayed until November at the latest.
